title: Welcome to the Hospitality Economy
coreMove: Service completes the transaction; hospitality designs the feeling people carry away. The durable edge comes from treating that feeling as part of the product.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Service and hospitality are two different things: service is competent execution (black and white), while hospitality is the human warmth and connection layered on top (color).
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A product is what you sell and service is how you deliver it, but hospitality is how you make a person feel during the exchange, and that feeling is the real differentiator.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.
